points.description: Names the convolutional layer (kernels/filters convolving over the input image) together with an activation layer (e.g. ReLU) as the feature-extraction part of the CNN.
points.partial_credit: Half if only the convolutional layer or only the activation layer is given.

points.description: Names the pooling layer (max or average pooling) and the final fully connected layer(s) followed by softmax/output layer.
points.partial_credit: Half if only pooling or only fully connected/softmax is given.
